segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report balanced, non-greasy hydration and reduced shine, though one suggests the serum may pill and suit oily skin better than others.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers generally report improved hydration, plumpness and softness over weeks of use, but some describe tightness, stinging, or a dry-down that leaves skin wanting more moisture.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report more even, glowy, non-oily skin and reduced hormonal breakouts, with one noting a shift from combination to dry skin made the serum feel drying.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most split: many with rosacea, eczema or reactive skin report calming, non-irritating results and reduced redness, while others describe burning, stinging or flare-ups on first use.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s-60s) report smoother, tighter, more youthful-looking skin with smaller pores and reduced fine lines with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother, tighter skin, reduced fine lines, crow's feet and forehead lines, and one long-term user notes visibly smaller pores; results are described as gradual with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe significant, lasting hydration and plumper skin after weeks of use; a minority report tightness, dryness, or the product drying out their skin instead.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers, including those with rosacea, report reduced redness and calmer skin over time; however, several describe immediate burning and visible redness lasting hours after application.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the serum with repairing a damaged or over-exfoliated barrier and reducing flaking, stinging and tightness, describing it as calming and restorative.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report reduced hyperpigmentation and more even skin tone with regular use; results on hyperpigmentation are described as gradual and still being evaluated by some.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal acne report fewer breakouts and less noticeable scarring; one reviewer states it caused breakouts and burning, and another says it did not improve scarring.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report a balanced, non-greasy finish and less shine; no reports of the serum making oiliness worse.

aspects.libelle: Immediate burning or stinging on application
Strong goat milk smell that fades quickly

extraits.titre: Made face hot, red and irritated
extraits.texte: Should have read the negative reviews first! Same thing happened to me, red, hot, burning sensation everywhere i applied product. Only had it on for under 5 mins thankfully and washed face with cold water, put on thick layer of aloe vera gel and my face was still hot and burning and RED. looked like bad sunburn. Put on more aloe gel. Rinsed with cold water again after about 15 minutes. Skin slowly calmed down and the redness eventually went away for the most part. Never had a reaction like this, thankful it wasn't worse. Dont usually leave reviews but maybe it will save someone from this horrible experience. Got it has a free birthday gift, throwing it out. :(

I can see how people love this serum, but it is not for all skin types. As I am settling into my 30s my skin has changed from combo to dry. I do not have sensitive skin so I have not experienced the burning or redness that others mention. The dry down is fast so that helps when layering products. I have not experienced a strong fragrance, it smells like a typical fragrance free formula and smells like nothing once dried completely. With dry skin, once absorbed it leaves my face feeling tight wanting for more hydration.

I've purchased this stuff 4x now and i'm about to buy another one. I have the worse type of skin: hormonal adult acne, hyperpigmentation, sensitive, etc. but i have felt like this has helped calmed the redness and lessen my acne scarring. It did take me a good 2-3 consistent months to really see and feel the difference but I will forever be loyal to this serum as long as they're here!

I had this one before. I think I got it in my fit fab fun box once but I never used it. Years passed and I rediscovered it on my stash I was afraid to use it because it was most likely too old. When I was presented with the options of Birthday Gifts at the Ulta store last October I jumped on it, and told myself this time around I'd def try it. I have battled with patches of eczema on my face for years. I've tried everything and the only thing that helps is of course the medicated cream my Doctor prescribed, which is fine but I often forget to use it unless it starts bothering me. The eczema often leaves a "scar" behind, so it's annoying to have to use the medicated stuff even when I don't have a flare up to prevent it. But then! I tried this little miracle. It not only cleared the flare up in ONE DAY, regular daily use Prevents it from flaring up. Maybe it's the ceramides? I have no idea! But I love it!!!!! The price of the full size one is def steep for me but this baby last, so I think it will be totally worth it to invest on it once this sample is gone. I don't know about any other skin issues, I read some reviews saying I may not be good for rosacea, but if you have ECZEMA, especially on the side of the nose, chin, eyelids, I TOTALLY recommend it! Little miracle!!!!!!

I have extremely dry and extremely sensitive skin (psoriasis and rosacea). I added this to my skincare routine after doing a training for the brand simply out of curiosity and I've received so many compliments on my skin since I started using it. My skin has not flared up as badly as it used to since I started using it. Absolutely 100% worth the price because my skin has never looked so good.

extraits.titre: I have used this product for more than a year
extraits.texte: I am 61 and love how this serum performs on my skin. I have tighter, softer skin with smaller pores. I have oily skin and this does not cause breakouts. Feels great and has a very mild scent - love Beekman and have used this entire line with great success.

extraits.titre: A little bottle that does big wonders.
extraits.texte: I got my delux sample with my purchase of the Milk Shake toner. While I did noticed some irritation in the neck (not as much as with retinol), this serum is a tremendous help. My skin looks even, nourished and younger (I'm in my early 40s). Milk Drops has done so much to my skin, I even cancelled my night peptide serum and switched to this one. Yes, it is pricey. However, after seeing the results, Milk Drops made me realize it really worths each buck.
